snippet.title: Speed Rivals – Official Demo Gameplay Trailer  🚗💥
snippet.description:
🛒 Play the FREE demo or add it to your wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3719310/Speed_Rivals_Demo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=demo&utm_content=en

🎮 Speed Rivals is here! Watch the official gameplay trailer showcasing high-speed action, precision slot-racing, and retro-futuristic tracks from the brand-new playable demo — available now on Steam!

🏁 Race, upgrade, and master over 30 unique cars across 4 circuits in this first taste of the indie racer everyone’s talking about.

💬 Follow us and join the community:

🔹 Twitter (X): https://x.com/babelgames_st 
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/babelgames_studio
👾 Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/Hot-Operation8832/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/pDUq96aFcH
